input.content:
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference
from openpyxl.chart.label import DataLabelList

src = '/home/user/Create_column_charts_using_statistics.xlsx'
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(src)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Chart 1: 2019 monthly totals (months A3:A14 vs totals I3:I14)
chart1 = BarChart()
chart1.type = "col"
chart1.style = 10
chart1.title = "Personal Costs - 2019 (Monthly Totals)"
chart1.y_axis.title = "Total Cost (£)"
chart1.x_axis.title = "Month"

data1 = Reference(ws, min_col=9, min_row=2, max_row=14, max_col=9)  # I2:I14 (header included? row 2 is empty for I)
# I2 is empty, so use I3:I14 with title from value? Better: use min_row=3 and add titles_from_data=False
data1 = Reference(ws, min_col=9, min_row=3, max_row=14, max_col=9)
cats1 = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=3, max_row=14)
chart1.add_data(data1, titles_from_data=False)
chart1.set_categories(cats1)
chart1.series[0].tx = openpyxl.chart.series.SeriesLabel(v="2019 Total")
chart1.legend = None
ws.add_chart(chart1, "K2")

# Chart 2: 2020 monthly totals (months A20:A31 vs totals I20:I31)
chart2 = BarChart()
chart2.type = "col"
chart2.style = 12
chart2.title = "Personal Costs - 2020 (Monthly Totals)"
chart2.y_axis.title = "Total Cost (£)"
chart2.x_axis.title = "Month"

data2 = Reference(ws, min_col=9, min_row=20, max_row=31, max_col=9)
cats2 = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=20, max_row=31)
chart2.add_data(data2, titles_from_data=False)
chart2.set_categories(cats2)
chart2.series[0].tx = openpyxl.chart.series.SeriesLabel(v="2020 Total")
chart2.legend = None
ws.add_chart(chart2, "K19")

wb.save(src)
print("Charts added and saved.")
